reference: MAME 0.276 assistant clone; Apollo DN3500; Domain/OS SR10.4 / HP VUE 2.01

initial_state.guest_screen: VUE desktop visible after a bounded Shift wake

actions.kind: blank desktop capture click and host relative movement
actions.input: A 60 ms XTest left click at guest desktop coordinate (900,300), in visibly empty space, was consumed for the documented recapture path; then a relative host XTest move of (-300,+150) was sent without a button.
actions.observation: The hook reported captured=true during the move, but the guest screenshot did not show a cursor over XmpIcon or a selection. Pixel differences against the nearby baseline were confined to clock/pager animation areas; no target hover was established.

actions.input: With hook released and mouse/device none, Mouse X was sampled from 3 to 19 for 18 frames, snapshotted, and cleared on frame 21.
actions.observation: The paired native snapshots showed no cursor displacement from this sample in the current post-capture state; only clock/pager animation pixels changed. This differs from the earlier R191 state and is inconclusive as a cursor calibration.

final_state.guest_screen: VUE desktop visible; Terminal and File Manager remain open; no icon selected or opened

limits: The intentional blank-space click verified the known capture-on-click behavior, not the reported physical screen-wake sequence. XTest relative motion and this counter sample did not yield a paired XmpIcon hover. No guest files/configuration were changed. Lua hook state is not a direct SDL grab query.
next: Do not repeat the blank click or one-axis sample without a new trajectory hypothesis. Continue only with the physical wake event when observable; otherwise proceed to the next independently measurable GTK2 control/state in I167 without applying the partial adapter to XChat.
